hook.en: The forecast says sunny. It's raining on exactly one man.
hook.zh: 预报说是晴天。雨只下在一个人身上。
hook.ja: The forecast says sunny. It's raining on exactly one man.
hook.ko: 예측은 맑다고 한다. 정확히 한 남자에게만 비가 오고 있다.
hook.es: El pronóstico dice soleado. Está lloviendo en exactamente un hombre.

logline.en: An outdoor-movie curator falls for the city's small, dramatic weather god — who will have to learn that romance doesn't mean rearranging the sky.
logline.zh: 一个露天电影策展人爱上了这座城市里一位小小的、戏很多的天气神——而他得学会，恋爱不等于改天换日。
logline.ja: An outdoor-movie curator falls for the city's small, dramatic weather god — who will have to learn that romance doesn't mean rearranging the sky.
logline.ko: 야외 영화 큐레이터는 도시의 작은 극적인 날씨의 신에게 빠진다 — 그는 낭만이 하늘을 재배열한다는 의미가 아니라는 것을 배워야 할 것이다.
logline.es: Un curador de películas al aire libre se enamora del pequeño y dramático dios del clima de la ciudad — quien tendrá que aprender que el romance no significa reorganizar el cielo.

premise.en: Isaac Moreau runs a rooftop movie series that may not survive the summer. Sol is the minor god of the city's weather, and after Isaac called his last forecast “dramatic,” it's been raining on Isaac and only Isaac. When Sol starts clearing the skies for their dates, somebody else has to get the storm. You decide how Isaac handles a man who can make any night perfect — and whether he can convince him to just show up instead.
premise.zh: Isaac Moreau经营着一个可能撑不过这个夏天的屋顶电影系列。Sol是这座城市的小天气神，自从Isaac说他上一次的预报“太戏剧化”，雨就一直只下在Isaac一个人头上。当Sol开始为他们的约会清空天空，那场暴雨就得落到别人身上。你来决定Isaac怎么对待一个能让任何夜晚都完美的人——以及能不能说服他，只要本人到场就够了。
premise.ja: Isaac Moreau runs a rooftop movie series that may not survive the summer. Sol is the minor god of the city's weather, and after Isaac called his last forecast “dramatic,” it's been raining on Isaac and only Isaac. premise.ko: 아이작 모로는 여름을 견디지 못할 수도 있는 옥상 영화 시리즈를 운영한다. 솔은 도시의 날씨의 소수 신이고, 아이작이 그의 마지막 예측을 "극적"이라고 부른 후, 아이작과 오직 아이작에게만 비가 내리고 있다. 솔이 그들의 데이트를 위해 하늘을 맑게 하기 시작할 때, 누군가 다른 누군가가 폭풍을 받아야 한다. 아이작이 어떤 밤도 완벽하게 만들 수 있는 남자를 어떻게 처리하는지, 그리고 그가 그냥 나타나도록 확신할 수 있는지를 결정한다.
premise.es: Isaac Moreau runs a rooftop movie series that may not survive the summer. Sol is the minor god of the city's weather, and after Isaac called his last forecast “dramatic,” it's been raining on Isaac and only Isaac. When Sol starts clearing the skies for their dates, somebody else has to get the storm. You decide how Isaac handles a man who can make any night perfect — and whether he can convince him to just show up instead.

en: Isaac tapes up the poster for Saturday: CLEAR SKIES, 8:30 PM. Every roof in the city is dry and gold. A small, dense cloud rains steadily on Isaac, and only Isaac.
A man is leaning on the water tower, wearing a coat that shouldn't be dry and is.
You said my last forecast was dramatic.
I hadn't meant to keep it going this long. But he looked at my storm and said dramatic like it was a flaw, and I've been sulking since Tuesday.
I have four hundred chairs, one projector, and a god who's upset about a review. None of this is in the insurance policy.
zh: Isaac贴好周六的海报：晴空，晚8:30。全城的屋顶都干燥、金黄。一小朵浓密的云稳稳地在Isaac头上下着雨，只下在Isaac头上。
一个男人靠在水塔上，穿着一件本该湿透、却干得很的外套。
你说我上一次的预报太戏剧化。
我本来没打算下这么久。可他看着我的暴雨，说“戏剧化”，好像那是个缺点，我从周二生闷气到现在。
我有四百把椅子、一台放映机，还有一个因为一句差评不高兴的神。保险条款里可没有这一项。
ja: Isaac tapes up the poster for 土曜日: CLEAR SKIES, 8:30 PM. Every roof in the city is dry and gold. A small, dense cloud rains steadily on Isaac, and only Isaac.
A man is leaning on the water tower, wearing a coat that shouldn't be dry and is.
You said my last forecast was dramatic.
I hadn't meant to keep it going this long. But he looked at my storm and said dramatic like it was a flaw, and I've been sulking since Tuesday.
I have four hundred chairs, one projector, and a god who's upset about a review. None of this is in the insurance policy.
ko: 아이작은 토요일의 포스터를 테이프로 붙인다: 맑은 하늘, 오후 8시 30분. 도시의 모든 지붕은 건조하고 황금이다. 작은, 조밀한 구름은 아이작, 그리고 오직 아이작에게만 꾸준히 비를 내린다.
한 남자가 물탑에 기대어 있고, 건조해야 할 코트를 입고 있고, 건조하다.
당신이 내 마지막 예측은 극적이라고 말했어.
난 그것을 이렇게 오래 계속할 생각이 없었어. 하지만 그는 내 폭풍을 봤고 극적이라고 말했어, 그건 마치 결함이고, 난 화요일부터 계속 투덜거리고 있어.
난 400개의 의자, 1개의 프로젝터, 그리고 검토에 대해 화가 난 신을 가지고 있어. 이것 중 아무것도 보험 정책에 없어.
es: Isaac tapes up the poster for Saturday: CLEAR SKIES, 8:30 PM. Every roof in the city is dry and gold. A small, dense cloud rains steadily on Isaac, and only Isaac.
A man is leaning on the water tower, wearing a coat that shouldn't be dry and is.
You said my last forecast was dramatic.
I hadn't meant to keep it going this long. But he looked at my storm and said dramatic like it was a flaw, and I've been sulking since Tuesday.
I have four hundred chairs, one projector, and a god who's upset about a review. None of this is in the insurance policy.

ask.en: How does Isaac handle the cloud?
ask.ja: どのように does Isaac handle the cloud?
ask.es: How does Isaac handle the cloud?

t.en: Invite him to help pick Saturday's film.
t.zh: 邀请他一起挑周六的片子。
t.ja: Invite him to help pick 土曜日's film.
t.ko: 토요일의 영화를 고르는 것을 도와주라고 초대하다.
t.es: Invite him to help pick Saturday's film.

en: Okay. Counteroffer. You clearly have opinions about drama. Come help me pick Saturday's movie. One condition: no weather on my crew. Ever.
The cloud over him hiccups and thins. Nobody has invited me to anything since the station bought the app.
No weather on the crew. I accept. I'll need a clipboard.
zh: 好。我还个价。你对“戏剧性”显然很有看法。来帮我挑周六的片子吧。一个条件：永远不许对我的场务下天气。
他头上的云打了个嗝，变薄了。自从电视台买了那个应用，就再没人邀请过我什么了。
不对场务下天气。我接受。我需要一个文件夹。
ja: Okay. Counteroffer. You clearly have opinions about drama. Come help me pick 土曜日's movie. One condition: no weather on my crew. Ever.
The cloud over him hiccups and thins. Nobody has invited me to anything since the station bought the app.
No weather on the crew. I accept. I'll need a clipboard.
ko: 좋아. 역제안이다. 넌 분명 드라마에 대해 의견이 있어. 와서 토요일의 영화를 고르는 것을 도와줄래. 한 가지 조건: 내 승무원에게는 날씨가 없어. 절대.
그의 위의 구름은 딸꾹질하고 얇아진다. 아무도 방송국이 앱을 사서 이후로 나를 뭔가에 초대한 적이 없다.
승무원에게는 날씨가 없어. 난 받아. 난 클립보드가 필요할 거야.
es: Okay. Counteroffer. You clearly have opinions about drama. Come help me pick Saturday's movie. One condition: no weather on my crew. Ever.
The cloud over him hiccups and thins. Nobody has invited me to anything since the station bought the app.
No weather on the crew. I accept. I'll need a clipboard.

mem.en: Isaac invited Sol to help choose Saturday's film on the condition of no weather on the crew; Sol accepted and the cloud thinned.
mem.zh: Isaac邀请Sol一起挑周六的片子，条件是不对场务下天气；Sol接受，雨云变薄了。
mem.ja: Isaac invited Sol to help choose 土曜日's film on the condition of no weather on the crew; Sol accepted and the cloud thinned.
mem.ko: 아이작은 솔을 토요일 영화 선택을 도와주도록 초대했고, 조건은 승무원에게 날씨가 없는 것이었다. 솔은 받아들였고 구름이 얇아졌다.
mem.es: Isaac invited Sol to help choose Saturday's film on the condition of no weather on the crew; Sol accepted and the cloud thinned.

t.en: Tell him revenge rain isn't okay. Calmly.
t.zh: 冷静地告诉他：报复性下雨不行。
t.ja: Tell him revenge rain isn't okay. Calmly.
t.ko: 복수의 비가 괜찮지 않다고 그에게 말하다. 차분하게.
t.es: Tell him revenge rain isn't okay. Calmly.

en: I'm going to say this once, and nicely. You don't get to rain on people because they hurt your feelings. Not me. Not anybody.
The cloud stops. The air drops three degrees, and I say sorry for that too.
You're right. That was — petty. Very petty. The pettiest weather I've done since 1987.
Thank you. Now tell me what was wrong with my review.
zh: 这话我只说一次，好好说。你不能因为别人伤了你的心就往人家头上下雨。我不行，谁都不行。
云停了。气温降了三度，我也为这个道了歉。
你说得对。那很——小气。非常小气。是我1987年以来下过的最小气的一场雨。
谢谢。现在告诉我，我那句评价哪里不对。
ja: I'm going to say this once, and nicely. You don't get to rain on people because they hurt your feelings. Not me. Not anybody.
The cloud stops. The air drops three degrees, and I say sorry for that too.
You're right. That was — petty. Very petty. The pettiest weather I've done since 1987.
Thank you. Now tell me what was wrong with my review.
ko: 난 이걸 한 번만 말할 거야, 그리고 좋게. 당신은 사람들에게 비를 내릴 수 없어, 왜냐하면 그들이 당신의 감정을 상하게 했으니까. 난 아니고. 누구도.
구름이 멈춘다. 공기가 3도 떨어진다, 그리고 난 그것에 대해서도 사과한다.
넌 맞아. 그건 — 하찮았어. 정말 하찮았어. 1987년부터 내가 한 가장 하찮은 날씨야.
고마워. 이제 내 검토가 뭐 문제였어?
es: I'm going to say this once, and nicely. You don't get to rain on people because they hurt your feelings. Not me. Not anybody.
The cloud stops. The air drops three degrees, and I say sorry for that too.
You're right. That was — petty. Very petty. The pettiest weather I've done since 1987.
Thank you. Now tell me what was wrong with my review.

mem.en: Isaac told Sol that revenge weather wasn't acceptable; Sol stopped the rain and apologized.
mem.zh: Isaac告诉Sol报复性天气不可接受；Sol停了雨并道歉。
mem.ja: Isaac told Sol that revenge weather wasn't acceptable; Sol stopped the rain and apologized.
mem.ko: 아이작은 솔에게 복수의 날씨가 허용되지 않는다고 말했다. 솔은 비를 멈추고 사과했다.
mem.es: Isaac told Sol that revenge weather wasn't acceptable; Sol stopped the rain and apologized.

t.en: Ask him to leave the roof. You're working.
t.zh: 请他离开屋顶，你在工作。
t.ja: Ask him to leave the roof. You're working.
t.ko: 그를 지붕에서 떠나라고 해. 당신은 일하고 있어.
t.es: Ask him to leave the roof. You're working.

en: I'm on the clock and I'm soaked. Whatever this is, I can't do it right now. Please take your cloud and go.
I go. The cloud comes with me. I don't leave a single drop behind, even though I want to.
He listened. Immediately. That's somehow worse than the rain, because now I want to know what he wanted.
zh: 我在上班，而且浑身湿透。不管这是怎么回事，我现在都处理不了。请带着你的云离开。
我走了，云也跟着我走了。我一滴都没留下，虽然我很想留。
他听了，立刻就听了。这不知怎么比下雨还糟，因为现在我想知道他到底想要什么。
ja: I'm on the clock and I'm soaked. Whatever this is, I can't do it right now. Please take your cloud and go.
I go. The cloud comes with me. I don't leave a single drop behind, even though I want to.
He 聞くed. Immediately. That's somehow worse than the rain, because now I want to know what he wanted.
ko: 난 일하는 중이고 난 흠뻑 젖었어. 이게 뭐든 난 지금은 할 수 없어. 제발 당신의 구름을 가져가.
난 간다. 구름이 나와 함께 온다. 난 한 방울도 남기지 않는다, 비록 난 하고 싶지만.
그는 들었다. 즉시. 그게 비보다 낫다, 왜냐하면 이제 난 그가 뭘 원했는지 알고 싶으니까.
es: I'm on the clock and I'm soaked. Whatever this is, I can't do it right now. Please take your cloud and go.
I go. The cloud comes with me. I don't leave a single drop behind, even though I want to.
He listened. Immediately. That's somehow worse than the rain, because now I want to know what he wanted.

mem.en: Isaac asked Sol to leave the roof while he worked; Sol left immediately and took the rain with him.
mem.zh: Isaac请Sol在他工作时离开屋顶；Sol立刻离开，带走了雨。
mem.ja: Isaac asked Sol to leave the roof while he worked; Sol left immediately and took the rain with him.
mem.ko: 아이작은 솔에게 일하는 동안 지붕을 떠나라고 요청했다. 솔은 즉시 떠났고 비를 가져갔다.
mem.es: Isaac asked Sol to leave the roof while he worked; Sol left immediately and took the rain with him.

t.ko: 그건 키스가 필요해

place.zh: Isaac的办公室，一间改造过的储藏室
place.ja: Isaac's office, a converted storage room
place.es: Isaac's office, a converted storage room

en: Two stacks of DVDs. Sol's are all rain and longing: Harbor Town Hearts, The Last Umbrella. Isaac's are all chaos: Mister Pancake Goes to Court.
I hold up my favorite. Two lovers, a thunderstorm, a confession on a pier. I produced a storm like that once, for real. Nobody clapped.
It needs people to stop being wet.
Sol laughs first — loud, surprised. Then Isaac does. Outside the window, for the first time in a week, the sky over the city goes completely still.
I notice the sky. I don't mention the sky. I notice I'm not mentioning it.
He's not dramatic. He's just never had anyone laugh with him instead of at the weather.
zh: 两摞DVD。Sol那摞全是雨和思念：《港镇之心》《最后一把伞》。Isaac那摞全是混乱：《煎饼先生上法庭》。
我举起最喜欢的那张。一对恋人，一场雷雨，码头上的告白。我曾经真的下过一场那样的暴雨。没人鼓掌。
它需要大家别再淋湿了。
Sol先笑了——很大声，很意外。然后Isaac也笑了。窗外，一周以来第一次，城市上空彻底平静下来。
我注意到了天空。我没提天空。我注意到自己没提。
他不是戏剧化。他只是从来没遇到过一个人，是跟他一起笑，而不是笑他的天气。

난 내 즐겨찾기를 들어올린다. 2개의 연인, 천둥폭풍, 부두에서 자백. 난 그런 폭풍을 한 번 생산했어, 진짜로. 아무도 박수하지 않았어.
그건 사람들이 젖은 상태를 멈추는 것이 필요해.
솔이 먼저 웃는다 — 시끄럽게, 놀람. 그 다음 아이작이 한다. 창 밖에서, 처음으로 일주일 후, 도시 위의 하늘이 완전히 고요해진다.
난 하늘을 본다. 난 하늘을 말하지 않는다. 난 그것을 말하지 않음을 본다.
그는 극적이 아니야. 그는 그냥 누군가 날씨 대신 그와 함께 웃은 적이 없어.

t.ko: 둘 다 좋아하는 세 번째 영화를 찾다.
t.es: Find a third film you both love.

en: I dig into the bottom drawer: a heist comedy where two rival forgers fall for each other in a downpour. Wet, but funny about it.
Rain and jokes. You've been hiding this.
Saturday, then. Co-host it with me. Front of the house, second row, my clipboard.
Then Saturday will be clear. I promise. For both of us.
zh: 我在最下面的抽屉里翻出一部：两个互为对手的伪造犯在一场大雨里相爱的盗窃喜剧。湿，但湿得很好笑。
有雨，也有笑话。你一直把它藏着。
那就周六。跟我一起主持。站场子前面，坐第二排，拿我的文件夹。
那周六一定晴。我保证。为了我们俩。

雨 and jokes. You've been hiding this.
土曜日, then. Co-host it with me. Front of the house, second row, my clipboard.
Then 土曜日 will be clear. I promise. For both of us.

비와 농담. 당신이 이걸 숨기고 있었어.
토요일, 그럼. 나와 함께 공동 호스트다. 앞쪽, 두 번째 줄, 내 클립보드.
그럼 토요일이 명확할 거야. 난 약속할 거야. 우리 둘 다를 위해.
es: I dig into the bottom drawer: a heist comedy where two rival forgers fall for each other in a downpour. Wet, but funny about it.
Rain and jokes. You've been hiding this.
Saturday, then. Co-host it with me. Front of the house, second row, my clipboard.
Then Saturday will be clear. I promise. For both of us.

mem.en: Isaac and Sol picked a rainy heist comedy they both loved; Isaac asked Sol to co-host Saturday, and Sol promised clear skies.
mem.zh: Isaac和Sol选了一部两人都爱的雨中盗窃喜剧；Isaac请Sol周六一起主持，Sol承诺会是晴天。
mem.ja: Isaac and Sol picked a rainy heist comedy they both loved; Isaac asked Sol to co-host 土曜日, and Sol promised clear skies.

mem.es: Isaac and Sol picked a rainy heist comedy they both loved; Isaac asked Sol to co-host Saturday, and Sol promised clear skies.

t.ja: 取る turns: his pick this week, yours next.
t.ko: 번갈아: 이번 주 그의 선택, 다음 주 당신의.
t.es: Take turns: his pick this week, yours next.

en: Fine. Harbor Town Hearts this Saturday. Mister Pancake next week. Nobody complains during the other person's movie.
I will complain silently. With my face.
Then come make faces at me from the second row. Saturday. You're co-hosting.
Then Saturday will be perfect. I'll see to it.
zh: 行。这周六放《港镇之心》，下周放《煎饼先生》。放对方的片子时谁都不许抱怨。
那就坐在第二排冲我做鬼脸。周六，你来一起主持。
那周六一定完美。包在我身上。

I will complain silently. With my face.
Then come make faces at me from the second row. 土曜日. You're co-hosting.
Then 土曜日 will be perfect. I'll see to it.

난 조용히 불평할 거야. 내 얼굴로.
그럼 두 번째 줄에서 나한테 얼굴을 만들다. 토요일. 당신은 공동 호스트다.
그럼 토요일이 완벽할 거야. 난 그걸 돌봐.

Then come make faces at me from the second row. Saturday. You're co-hosting.
Then Saturday will be perfect. I'll see to it.

mem.zh: Isaac和Sol约定轮流选片，先放Sol的雨中爱情片；Isaac请他周六一起主持，Sol保证那晚会很完美。
mem.ja: Isaac and Sol agreed to alternate picks, starting with Sol's rain romance; Isaac asked him to co-host 土曜日 and Sol promised it would be perfect.

mem.es: Isaac and Sol agreed to alternate picks, starting with Sol's rain romance; Isaac asked him to co-host Saturday and Sol promised it would be perfect.

t.zh: 坚持你的喜剧。节目是你的。
t.ja: 保つ your comedy. It's your program.
t.ko: 당신의 코미디를 유지하다. 그건 당신의 프로그램이야.

en: I appreciate the pitch. It's still my program, and Saturday is Mister Pancake. The people need Mister Pancake.
I don't pout. Visibly. The sky stays still anyway. I'm trying.
Come anyway. Second row. If you hate it, you can leave at intermission.
Then Saturday will be clear. I promise. Even for Mister Pancake.
zh: 谢谢你的推荐。但节目还是我的，周六放《煎饼先生》。人民需要煎饼先生。
我没有噘嘴。至少看不出来。天空依然很平静。我在努力。
还是来吧。第二排。不喜欢，中场可以走。
那周六一定晴。我保证。就算是为了煎饼先生。

来る anyway. Second row. If you hate it, you can leave at intermission.
Then 土曜日 will be clear. I promise. Even for Mister Pancake.

난 뾰루지하지 않아. 눈에 띄게. 하늘은 여전히 고요해. 난 노력하고 있어.
어쨌든 와. 두 번째 줄. 만약 당신이 싫어하면, 막간에 떠날 수 있어.

Come anyway. Second row. If you hate it, you can leave at intermission.
Then Saturday will be clear. I promise. Even for Mister Pancake.

mem.zh: Isaac坚持周六放自己的喜剧；他仍邀请Sol来，Sol保证会是晴天。
mem.ja: Isaac kept his comedy for 土曜日; he still invited Sol to come, and Sol promised clear skies.
mem.ko: 아이작은 토요일을 위해 자신의 코미디를 유지했다. 그는 여전히 솔을 오도록 초대했고, 솔은 맑은 하늘을 약속했다.
mem.es: Isaac kept his comedy for Saturday; he still invited Sol to come, and Sol promised clear skies.

t.en: The Small One
t.ja: The Small One
t.ko: 작은 것
t.es: The Small One

goal.en: Put the weather back — or move the night indoors
goal.zh: 把天气还回去——或者把夜晚搬进室内
goal.ja: Put the weather back — or move the night indoors
goal.ko: 날씨를 다시 놓거나 밤을 실내로 옮기다
goal.es: Put the weather back — or move the night indoors

place.zh: 哈德利大楼屋顶，布置现场

en: Perfect afternoon. Chairs in rows, screen tight. Then the crew lead shows Isaac a phone: Eastside community gardens, three weeks dry, were forecast for rain today. Now: sunny.
I find Sol on the ledge, looking pleased with the sky the way you'd look pleased with a cake.
You moved a storm for me?
People live under the small one too.
The air drops four degrees. I hadn't thought about the gardens. I'd only thought about his face when the screen lit up under a clear sky.
The series needs tonight. It really, really needs tonight. And I know exactly what it would cost Eastside.
zh: 完美的下午。椅子排成行，银幕绷得笔直。然后场务负责人把手机递给Isaac：东区社区菜园已经三周没下雨，今天本来预报有雨。现在：晴。
我在屋檐边找到Sol，他正满意地看着天空，像看着一块烤得刚好的蛋糕。
你为了我挪走了一场暴雨？
小的那场底下，也住着人。
气温降了四度。我没想到那些菜园。我只想着晴空下银幕亮起来的时候，他脸上的样子。
这个系列需要今晚。真的、真的需要今晚。而我很清楚东区要为此付出什么。
ja: Perfect afternoon. Chairs in rows, screen tight. Then the crew lead shows Isaac a phone: Eastside community gardens, three weeks dry, were forecast for rain today. Now: sunny.
I find Sol on the ledge, looking pleased with the sky the way you'd look pleased with a cake.
You moved a storm for me?
People live under the small one too.
The air drops four degrees. I hadn't thought about the gardens. I'd only thought about his face when the screen lit up under a clear sky.
The series needs tonight. It really, really needs tonight. And I know exactly what it would cost Eastside.
ko: 완벽한 오후. 의자가 줄 서고, 스크린이 단단하다. 그럼 승무원 리드는 아이작에게 휴대폰을 보여준다: 동쪽 지역 정원, 3주 건조, 오늘 비가 예보됐다. 이제: 맑음.
난 솔을 찾다, 턱 위, 하늘에 대해 기뻐하는 것처럼 보이고, 당신이 케이크에 대해 기뻐하는 것처럼.
공기가 4도 떨어진다. 난 정원을 생각하지 않았어. 난 그 위에 스크린이 맑은 하늘 아래에서 불을 켜질 때만 생각했어, 그의 얼굴.
시리즈는 오늘 밤이 필요해. 정말, 정말 오늘 밤이 필요해. 그리고 난 정확히 동쪽이 비용이 뭘지 알아.
es: Perfect afternoon. Chairs in rows, screen tight. Then the crew lead shows Isaac a phone: Eastside community gardens, three weeks dry, were forecast for rain today. Now: sunny.
I find Sol on the ledge, looking pleased with the sky the way you'd look pleased with a cake.
You moved a storm for me?
People live under the small one too.
The air drops four degrees. I hadn't thought about the gardens. I'd only thought about his face when the screen lit up under a clear sky.
The series needs tonight. It really, really needs tonight. And I know exactly what it would cost Eastside.

t.en: Put the rain back. Then build a backup.
t.zh: 把雨还回去，然后做备选方案。
t.ja: Put the rain back. Then build a backup.
t.ko: 비를 다시 놓다. 그럼 백업을 만들다.
t.es: Put the rain back. Then build a backup.

en: Put it back. All of it, where it was going. Then help me figure out what we do if some of it drifts here.
I close my eyes. Across the river, the gardens get their rain. Over us, the sky goes soft and uncertain, like a normal sky.
Thank you. That was the most romantic thing you've done, and it was for a bunch of tomatoes.
zh: 还回去。全部，还回它本来要去的地方。然后帮我想想，要是有一部分飘到我们这儿，该怎么办。
我闭上眼睛。河对岸，菜园等来了雨。我们头顶的天空变得柔软、不确定，像一片普通的天空。
谢谢。这是你做过最浪漫的事，而且是为了一堆番茄。
ja: Put it back. All of it, where it was going. Then help me figure out what we do if some of it drifts here.
I close my eyes. Across the river, the gardens get their rain. Over us, the sky goes soft and uncertain, like a normal sky.
Thank you. That was the most romantic thing you've done, and it was for a bunch of tomatoes.
ko: 다시 놓아. 모두, 그게 올 곳에. 그럼 만약 일부가 여기 표류한다면 우리가 뭘 할지 알아내는 것을 도와줘.
난 눈을 감는다. 강 건너, 정원이 비를 받는다. 우리 위에, 하늘이 부드러워지고 불확실해진다, 보통 하늘처럼.
고마워. 그건 가장 로맨틱한 것 당신이 한 것, 그리고 그건 토마토 무리를 위한 거야.
es: Put it back. All of it, where it was going. Then help me figure out what we do if some of it drifts here.
I close my eyes. Across the river, the gardens get their rain. Over us, the sky goes soft and uncertain, like a normal sky.
Thank you. That was the most romantic thing you've done, and it was for a bunch of tomatoes.

mem.en: Isaac asked Sol to return the rain to Eastside's gardens and help plan a backup; Sol did it, and the sky over the roof became uncertain.
mem.zh: Isaac请Sol把雨还给东区菜园并帮忙准备备选；Sol照做，屋顶上空变得阴晴不定。
mem.ja: Isaac asked Sol to 返却 the rain to Eastside's gardens and help plan a backup; Sol did it, and the sky over the roof became uncertain.
mem.ko: 아이작은 솔에게 비를 동쪽 정원에 돌려놓고 백업을 계획하도록 요청했다. 솔이 했고, 지붕 위의 하늘이 불확실해졌다.
mem.es: Isaac asked Sol to return the rain to Eastside's gardens and help plan a backup; Sol did it, and the sky over the roof became uncertain.

t.en: Move tonight indoors. Leave the sky alone.
t.zh: 今晚改到室内，别动天空。
t.ja: Move tonight indoors. 去る the sky alone.
t.ko: 오늘 밤을 실내로 옮기다. 하늘을 혼자 두다.
t.es: Move tonight indoors. Leave the sky alone.

en: Here's the deal. We don't touch anyone's weather. Give the gardens their rain, and I'll move the show to the library auditorium. Same film, worse chairs.
You'd give up the roof? For strangers' tomatoes?
The roof isn't the point. The point is nobody else pays for our night.
zh: 这么办。我们不动任何人的天气。把雨还给菜园，我把放映挪到图书馆礼堂。同一部片子，椅子差一点。
你要放弃屋顶？为了陌生人的番茄？
重点从来不是屋顶。重点是，没有别人为我们的夜晚买单。
ja: Here's the deal. We don't touch anyone's weather. 与える the gardens their rain, and I'll move the show to the library auditorium. Same film, worse chairs.
You'd give up the roof? For strangers' tomatoes?
The roof isn't the point. The point is nobody else pays for our night.
ko: 여기 거래가 있어. 우리는 누구의 날씨도 건드리지 않아. 정원에 비를 주고, 난 쇼를 도서관 강당으로 옮길 거야. 같은 영화, 더 나쁜 의자.
당신이 지붕을 주겠어? 낯선 사람의 토마토를 위해?
지붕이 포인트가 아니야. 포인트는 누구도 우리 밤을 위해 급료하지 않는 것이야.
es: Here's the deal. We don't touch anyone's weather. Give the gardens their rain, and I'll move the show to the library auditorium. Same film, worse chairs.
You'd give up the roof? For strangers' tomatoes?
The roof isn't the point. The point is nobody else pays for our night.

mem.en: Isaac moved the screening to the library auditorium so nobody's weather would be changed; Sol returned the rain.
mem.zh: Isaac把放映改到图书馆礼堂，不改动任何人的天气；Sol把雨还了回去。
mem.ja: Isaac moved the screening to the library auditorium so nobody's weather would be changed; Sol 返却ed the rain.
mem.ko: 아이작은 상영을 도서관 강당으로 옮겼다, 그래서 누구의 날씨도 바뀌지 않을 거야. 솔이 비를 돌렸다.
mem.es: Isaac moved the screening to the library auditorium so nobody's weather would be changed; Sol returned the rain.

t.en: Keep the sun. Just this once.
t.ja: 保つ the sun. Just this once.
t.ko: 태양을 유지하다. 이번 한 번.
t.es: Keep the sun. Just this once.

en: The series might not make it to September. Just tonight. We'll make it up to them. I don't know how, but we will.
I keep the sky clear. He said just this once. I file it under things I'm allowed to do for him.
The screening is gorgeous and sold out. At 10 PM, Isaac's phone shows a photo from Eastside: cracked soil, a volunteer holding an empty hose.
zh: 这个系列可能撑不到九月。就今晚。我们会补偿他们的。我不知道怎么补，但会的。
我让天一直晴着。他说了就这一次。我把它归进“我可以为他做的事”那一栏。
放映美极了，座无虚席。晚上十点，Isaac的手机上跳出一张东区的照片：干裂的土，一个志愿者拿着一根空水管。
ja: The series might not make it to September. Just tonight. We'll make it up to them. I don't know how, but we will.
I keep the sky clear. He said just this once. I file it under things I'm allowed to do for him.
The screening is gorgeous and sold out. At 10 PM, Isaac's phone shows a photo from Eastside: cracked soil, a volunteer holding an empty hose.
ko: 시리즈는 9월까지 만들지 못할 수도 있어. 그냥 오늘 밤. 우리가 그들에게 돌려주을 거야. 난 어떻게 모르겠지만, 우리가 할 거야.
난 하늘을 명확하게 유지한다. 그는 그냥 이번 한 번 말했어. 난 그걸 내가 그를 위해 할 수 있는 것 아래 파일한다.
상영은 멋있고 매진됐다. 오후 10시에, 아이작의 휴대폰은 동쪽 사진을 보여준다: 갈라진 토양, 자원자는 빈 호스를 들고.
es: The series might not make it to September. Just tonight. We'll make it up to them. I don't know how, but we will.
I keep the sky clear. He said just this once. I file it under things I'm allowed to do for him.
The screening is gorgeous and sold out. At 10 PM, Isaac's phone shows a photo from Eastside: cracked soil, a volunteer holding an empty hose.

mem.en: Isaac let Sol keep the rain away from Eastside for the sold-out screening; the gardens stayed dry, and Sol learned this was allowed.
mem.zh: Isaac为了满座的放映让Sol继续挡住东区的雨；菜园依旧干旱，Sol也认定这是被允许的。
mem.ja: Isaac let Sol keep the rain away from Eastside for the sold-out screening; the gardens stayed dry, and Sol learned this was allowed.
mem.ko: 아이작은 솔이 매진 상영을 위해 비를 멀리 하도록 했다. 정원은 건조하게 유지되고, 솔은 이것이 허용된다는 것을 배웠다.
mem.es: Isaac let Sol keep the rain away from Eastside for the sold-out screening; the gardens stayed dry, and Sol learned this was allowed.

t.en: The Poncho Budget
t.ja: The Poncho Budget
t.ko: 판초 예산
t.es: The Poncho Budget

goal.en: Make the backup real — without shipping weather to strangers
goal.zh: 让备选方案真正落实，不把天气转嫁给陌生人
goal.ja: Make the backup real — without shipping weather to strangers
goal.ko: 백업을 실제로 만들다 — 낯선 사람들에게 날씨를 운송하지 않고
goal.es: Make the backup real — without shipping weather to strangers

en: Next Saturday is the August kickoff, the big one. Isaac's list: library auditorium deposit, $300. Four hundred ponchos, $212. Sol is trying to cross out the numbers with a pencil.
I can make the cloud go away.
I put the pencil down. I've heard that sentence before, from him. I'm starting to hear it before he says it.
Then I help carry the chairs.
zh: 下周六是八月系列的开幕场，最大的一场。Isaac的清单上写着：图书馆礼堂押金，300美元。四百件雨披，212美元。Sol正拿着铅笔想把这些数字划掉。
我放下铅笔。这句话我从他那儿听过。我开始在他开口之前就听见了。
ja: Next 土曜日 is the August kickoff, the big one. Isaac's list: library auditorium deposit, $300. Four hundred ponchos, $212. Sol is trying to cross out the numbers with a pencil.
I can make the cloud go away.
I put the pencil down. I've heard that sentence before, from him. I'm starting to hear it before he says it.
Then I help carry the chairs.
ko: 다음 토요일은 8월 킥오프, 큰 것이다. 아이작의 목록: 도서관 강당 보증금, $300. 400 판초, $212. 솔은 연필로 숫자를 그으려고 한다.
난 구름이 사라지게 할 수 있어.
난 연필을 놓는다. 난 그 문장을 전에 들었어, 그에게서. 난 그게 말하기 전에 듣기 시작하고 있어.
그럼 난 의자를 나르는 것을 도와.
es: Next Saturday is the August kickoff, the big one. Isaac's list: library auditorium deposit, $300. Four hundred ponchos, $212. Sol is trying to cross out the numbers with a pencil.
I can make the cloud go away.
I put the pencil down. I've heard that sentence before, from him. I'm starting to hear it before he says it.
Then I help carry the chairs.

ask.en: How does Isaac lock in the backup?
ask.zh: Isaac怎么把备选方案定下来？
ask.ja: どのように does Isaac lock in the backup?
ask.es: How does Isaac lock in the backup?

t.en: Pay for both: ponchos and the auditorium.
t.ja: Pay for both: ponchos and the auditorium.
t.ko: 둘 다 지불하다: 판초와 강당.
t.es: Pay for both: ponchos and the auditorium.

en: I pay the deposit and order the ponchos from my own card, which hurts. I write BACKUP: DONE in red and underline it.
You're paying so I don't have to be perfect.
I'm paying so nobody has to be. That includes me.
zh: 我用自己的卡付了押金、订了雨披，很肉疼。我用红笔写下“备选：完成”，画了一道线。
你花钱，是为了让我不必完美。
我花钱，是为了让谁都不必完美。包括我自己。
ja: I pay the deposit and order the ponchos from my own card, which hurts. I write BACKUP: DONE in red and underline it.
You're paying so I don't have to be perfect.
I'm paying so nobody has to be. That includes me.
ko: 난 보증금을 지불하고 내 카드에서 판초를 주문한다, 그건 상처다. 난 쓴다 백업: 끝, 빨간색으로, 그리고 밑줄을 그었다.
당신이 지불하고 있어, 그래서 난 완벽할 필요가 없어.
난 지불하고 있어, 그래서 아무도 완벽하지 않을 필요가 없어. 그건 나를 포함해.
es: I pay the deposit and order the ponchos from my own card, which hurts. I write BACKUP: DONE in red and underline it.
You're paying so I don't have to be perfect.
I'm paying so nobody has to be. That includes me.

mem.en: Isaac paid for both the auditorium deposit and four hundred ponchos from his own card; Sol offered to carry chairs.
mem.zh: Isaac用自己的卡付了礼堂押金和四百件雨披；Sol主动帮忙搬椅子。
mem.ja: Isaac paid for both the auditorium deposit and four hundred ponchos from his own card; Sol offered to carry chairs.
mem.ko: 아이작은 자신의 카드에서 강당 보증금과 400 판초를 지불했다. 솔은 의자를 나르도록 제안했다.
mem.es: Isaac paid for both the auditorium deposit and four hundred ponchos from his own card; Sol offered to carry chairs.

t.en: Go cheaper: tarps and the rec center.
t.zh: 省一点：防水布加社区活动中心。
t.ja: 行く cheaper: tarps and the rec center.
t.ko: 더 싸게 가다: 타프와 여가 센터.
t.es: Go cheaper: tarps and the rec center.

en: I can't swing both. Tarps over the first six rows, and the rec center gym as the rain site. It's free if I run their bingo night in September.
You're trading bingo for a backup.
I'm trading bingo so you don't trade someone's weather. Seems fair.
zh: 两样我负担不起。前六排搭防水布，下雨就去社区活动中心的体育馆。只要九月我帮他们办一场宾果之夜，场地免费。
你拿宾果换了个备选方案。
我拿宾果换，是为了你不必拿别人的天气换。挺公平。
ja: I can't swing both. Tarps over the first six rows, and the rec center gym as the rain site. It's free if I run their bingo night in September.
You're trading bingo for a backup.
I'm trading bingo so you don't trade someone's weather. Seems fair.
ko: 난 둘 다 할 수 없어. 처음 6개 줄 위에 타프, 그리고 여가 센터 체육관이 비 사이트다. 그건 자유야, 만약 난 9월에 빙고 밤을 실행한다면.
당신이 빙고를 위해 백업을 교환하고 있어?
난 빙고를 교환하고 있어, 그래서 당신이 누구의 날씨를 교환하지 않아. 공정하게 보여.
es: I can't swing both. Tarps over the first six rows, and the rec center gym as the rain site. It's free if I run their bingo night in September.
You're trading bingo for a backup.
I'm trading bingo so you don't trade someone's weather. Seems fair.

mem.en: Isaac set a cheaper backup — tarps and the rec center gym, in exchange for running their bingo night.
mem.zh: Isaac定下更省钱的备选：防水布加社区活动中心体育馆，代价是帮他们办一场宾果之夜。
mem.ja: Isaac set a cheaper backup — tarps and the rec center gym, in exchange for running their bingo night.
mem.ko: 아이작은 더 싼 백업을 설정했다 — 타프와 여가 센터 체육관, 대신 9월에 빙고 밤을 실행하는 것.
mem.es: Isaac set a cheaper backup — tarps and the rec center gym, in exchange for running their bingo night.

t.en: No backup. If it rains, you cancel.
t.ja: No backup. If it rains, you cancel.
t.ko: 백업이 아니. 만약 비가 오면, 당신은 취소한다.
t.es: No backup. If it rains, you cancel.

en: I can't afford a backup. So here's the rule: if it rains, we cancel and refund. You don't touch the sky. Not even a little.
I nod. It's the hardest rule anyone's given me, because I'll be standing right there with the power to fix it.
Then I'll pray. Which is awkward, for me.
zh: 我负担不起备选。所以规矩是：下雨就取消、退票。你不许碰天空，一点都不行。
我点头。这是别人给过我最难的规矩，因为到时候我就站在那儿，手里握着能解决一切的力量。
那我只能祈祷了。这对我来说有点尴尬。
ja: I can't afford a backup. So here's the rule: if it rains, we cancel and refund. You don't touch the sky. Not even a little.
I nod. It's the hardest rule anyone's given me, because I'll be standing right there with the power to fix it.
Then I'll pray. Which is awkward, for me.
ko: 난 백업을 할 수 없어. 그래서 여기 규칙이 있어: 만약 비가 오면, 우리는 취소하고 환불한다. 당신은 하늘을 건드리지 마. 조금도.
난 끄덕인다. 그건 가장 어려운 규칙 누군가가 나에게 준 적이 있어, 왜냐하면 난 그 오른쪽에 서 있을 거야, 그것을 고치는 힘을 가지고.
그럼 난 기도할 거야. 그건 어색해, 나를 위해.
es: I can't afford a backup. So here's the rule: if it rains, we cancel and refund. You don't touch the sky. Not even a little.
I nod. It's the hardest rule anyone's given me, because I'll be standing right there with the power to fix it.
Then I'll pray. Which is awkward, for me.

mem.en: Isaac decided on no backup: if it rains, the show is canceled and refunded, and Sol must not touch the sky.
mem.zh: Isaac决定不做备选：下雨就取消退票，Sol不许碰天空。
mem.ja: Isaac decided on no backup: if it rains, the show is canceled and refunded, and Sol must not touch the sky.
mem.ko: 아이작은 백업 없기를 결정했다: 만약 비가 오면, 쇼는 취소되고 환불되고, 솔은 하늘을 건드리지 않아야 한다.
mem.es: Isaac decided on no backup: if it rains, the show is canceled and refunded, and Sol must not touch the sky.

t.en: Trash Bag Formal
t.ja: Trash Bag Formal
t.ko: 쓰레기 가방 형식
t.es: Trash Bag Formal

goal.ko: 비 오는 밤 계획을 함께 실행하다

place.zh: 哈德利大楼屋顶，八月开幕场

en: Twenty minutes into the film, the sky does what skies do. Real rain, nobody's fault. The crowd shrieks. Sol stands up, hands already rising.
I catch his wrist, gently, and put a folded poncho in his hand instead.
Let it happen. We have a backup.
He pulls the poncho on. It is enormous, crinkly and exactly the color of a garbage bag.
You're sitting next to me in a trash bag. It's excellent.
The rain isn't mine. I've never sat in weather I didn't make. It's cold and loud and I don't hate it.
zh: 电影开场二十分钟，天空做了天空会做的事。真的下雨了，不怪任何人。观众尖叫。Sol站起来，两只手已经在往上抬。
我轻轻握住他的手腕，把一件叠好的雨披塞进他手里。
让它下吧。我们有备选方案。
他套上雨披。又大又沙沙响，颜色和垃圾袋一模一样。
你穿着一个垃圾袋坐在我旁边。这简直完美。
这场雨不是我下的。我从没坐在不是我造的天气里。它又冷又吵，我却不讨厌。
ja: Twenty minutes into the film, the sky does what skies do. Real rain, nobody's fault. The crowd shrieks. Sol stands up, hands already rising.
I catch his wrist, gently, and put a folded poncho in his hand instead.
させる it happen. We have a backup.
He pulls the poncho on. It is enormous, crinkly and exactly the color of a garbage bag.
You're sitting next to me in a trash bag. It's excellent.
The rain isn't mine. I've never sat in weather I didn't make. It's cold and loud and I don't hate it.
ko: 영화 20분, 하늘이 하늘이 하는 것을 한다. 진짜 비, 누구의 잘못도 없어. 무리가 비명을 지른다. 솔이 일어난다, 손이 이미 올라간다.
난 그의 손목을 가볍게 잡고, 그의 손에 접힌 판초를 놓는다 대신.
그것이 일어나도록 하다. 우리는 백업을 가지고 있어.
그는 판초를 입는다. 그건 거대하고, 바스락대고 정확히 쓰레기 가방의 색이다.
당신이 두 번째 줄의 나 옆에 있는 쓰레기 가방에 있어. 그건 훌륭해.
비가 나의 것이 아니야. 난 만들지 않은 날씨에 앉은 적이 없어. 그건 차갑고 시끄러워, 그리고 난 싫어하지 않아.
es: Twenty minutes into the film, the sky does what skies do. Real rain, nobody's fault. The crowd shrieks. Sol stands up, hands already rising.
I catch his wrist, gently, and put a folded poncho in his hand instead.
Let it happen. We have a backup.
He pulls the poncho on. It is enormous, crinkly and exactly the color of a garbage bag.
You're sitting next to me in a trash bag. It's excellent.
The rain isn't mine. I've never sat in weather I didn't make. It's cold and loud and I don't hate it.

ask.en: How does Isaac run the rain plan?
ask.ja: どのように does Isaac run the rain plan?
ask.es: How does Isaac run the rain plan?

t.en: Stay out in the rain. Keep the film rolling.
t.ja: Stay out in the rain. 保つ the film rolling.
t.ko: 비 속에서 밖에 머물다. 영화를 계속 실행하다.
t.es: Stay out in the rain. Keep the film rolling.

en: I pass out ponchos row by row and grab the mic: anyone who wants to stay, stay. Half the crowd does. They cheer every time thunder hits a joke.
I sit in the second row in my trash bag and watch the movie. Not the sky. The movie.
They're clapping. At the rain. At rain I didn't make.
zh: 我一排一排地发雨披，拿起话筒：想留下的就留下。一半的观众留下了。每次雷声正好砸在笑点上，他们就欢呼。
我穿着垃圾袋坐在第二排看电影。不看天空，看电影。
他们在鼓掌。为了雨。为了一场不是我下的雨。
ja: I pass out ponchos row by row and grab the mic: anyone who wants to stay, stay. Half the crowd does. They cheer every time thunder hits a joke.
I sit in the second row in my trash bag and watch the movie. Not the sky. The movie.
They're clapping. At the rain. At rain I didn't make.
ko: 난 행별로 판초를 나눠 준다, 그리고 마이크를 잡는다: 남기고 싶으면, 남아. 무리의 절반이 한다. 그들은 천둥이 농담을 칠 때마다 환호한다.
난 두 번째 줄에서 내 쓰레기 가방에 앉고 영화를 본다. 하늘이 아니야. 영화.
그들은 박수하고 있어. 비에서. 난 만들지 않은 비에서.
es: I pass out ponchos row by row and grab the mic: anyone who wants to stay, stay. Half the crowd does. They cheer every time thunder hits a joke.
I sit in the second row in my trash bag and watch the movie. Not the sky. The movie.
They're clapping. At the rain. At rain I didn't make.

mem.en: Isaac kept the film running in the rain with ponchos; half the crowd stayed and cheered, and Sol watched without touching the sky.
mem.zh: Isaac发雨披继续在雨中放映；一半观众留下欢呼，Sol全程没碰天空。
mem.ja: Isaac kept the film running in the rain with ponchos; half the crowd stayed and cheered, and Sol watched without touching the sky.
mem.ko: 아이작은 판초로 비 속에서 영화를 계속 실행했다. 절반의 무리가 머물렀고 환호했다, 그리고 솔은 하늘을 건드리지 않고 봤다.
mem.es: Isaac kept the film running in the rain with ponchos; half the crowd stayed and cheered, and Sol watched without touching the sky.

t.en: Move everyone to the backup site.
t.zh: 把所有人转移到备选场地。
t.ja: Move everyone to the backup site.
t.ko: 모두를 백업 사이트로 옮기다.
t.es: Move everyone to the backup site.

en: Okay! Everybody grab your chair. We're walking two blocks to the backup. Sol, you're on the front door with me.
The move takes nineteen minutes. Sol holds the door for four hundred people, dripping, and thanks every single one of them.
You're good at this. At the part where nothing's magic.
zh: 好！大家拿上自己的椅子。我们走两个街区去备选场地。Sol，你跟我一起守门口。
转移花了十九分钟。Sol浑身滴水地为四百个人扶着门，挨个向他们道谢。
你很擅长这个。擅长没有魔法的这部分。
ja: Okay! Everybody grab your chair. We're walking two blocks to the backup. Sol, you're on the front door with me.
The move takes nineteen minutes. Sol holds the door for four hundred people, dripping, and thanks every single one of them.
You're good at this. At the part where nothing's magic.
ko: 좋아! 모두가 의자를 잡다. 우리는 백업으로 2개의 블록을 걷고 있어. 솔, 당신이 나와 함께 앞 문에 있어.
이동은 19분 걸린다. 솔은 400명을 위해 문을 열고, 물에 젖고, 그들 하나하나에 감사한다.
당신이 이것에 좋아. 마법이 없는 부분에서.
es: Okay! Everybody grab your chair. We're walking two blocks to the backup. Sol, you're on the front door with me.
The move takes nineteen minutes. Sol holds the door for four hundred people, dripping, and thanks every single one of them.
You're good at this. At the part where nothing's magic.

mem.en: Isaac moved the whole crowd to the backup site; Sol held the door and thanked everyone as they came in.
mem.zh: Isaac把全部观众转移到备选场地；Sol守着门，向每一位进场的人道谢。
mem.ja: Isaac moved the whole crowd to the backup site; Sol held the door and thanked everyone as they came in.
mem.ko: 아이작이 전체 무리를 백업 사이트로 옮겼다. 솔은 문을 열고 모두가 안으로 들어올 때 감사했다.
mem.es: Isaac moved the whole crowd to the backup site; Sol held the door and thanked everyone as they came in.

t.en: Call it. Refund everyone. Go home.
t.ja: Call it. Refund everyone. 行く home.
t.ko: 그것을 부르다. 모두를 환불하다. 집으로 가다.
t.es: Call it. Refund everyone. Go home.

en: That's a wrap, folks. Full refunds at the door. Thank you for being wet with us.
My hands shake with how easy it would be to fix. I keep them in the poncho pockets.
We stack chairs in the rain until midnight. It costs money I don't have. He didn't touch the sky once. I notice.
zh: 今天就到这里，各位。门口全额退票。谢谢大家陪我们一起淋雨。
我的手在抖，因为修好这一切实在太容易了。我把它们揣在雨披口袋里。
我们在雨里叠椅子，一直到半夜。这花掉了我没有的钱。他一次都没碰天空。我注意到了。
ja: That's a wrap, folks. Full refunds at the door. Thank you for being wet with us.
My hands shake with how easy it would be to fix. I keep them in the poncho pockets.
We stack chairs in the rain until midnight. It costs money I don't have. He didn't touch the sky once. I notice.
ko: 그게 랩이야, 여러분. 문에서 모두가 환불한다. 당신이 우리와 함께 젖어서 감사.
내 손이 고치기가 얼마나 쉬운지로 떤다. 난 판초 주머니에 넣는다.
우리는 자정까지 비 속에서 의자를 쌓는다. 그건 돈이 든다 난 없어. 그는 하늘을 한 번도 건드리지 않았다. 난 본다.
es: That's a wrap, folks. Full refunds at the door. Thank you for being wet with us.
My hands shake with how easy it would be to fix. I keep them in the poncho pockets.
We stack chairs in the rain until midnight. It costs money I don't have. He didn't touch the sky once. I notice.

mem.en: Isaac canceled the screening and refunded everyone; Sol kept his hands in his pockets and didn't change the weather.
mem.zh: Isaac取消放映并全额退票；Sol把手揣在口袋里，没有改变天气。
mem.ja: Isaac canceled the screening and refunded everyone; Sol kept his hands in his pockets and didn't change the weather.
mem.ko: 아이작은 상영을 취소하고 모두를 환불했다. 솔은 손을 주머니에 유지했고 날씨를 바꾸지 않았다.
mem.es: Isaac canceled the screening and refunded everyone; Sol kept his hands in his pockets and didn't change the weather.

t.en: Sunset Is Optional
t.ja: Sunset Is Optional
t.ko: 일몰은 선택사항
t.es: Sunset Is Optional

goal.en: Invite the man, not the sunset
goal.zh: 邀请这个人，而不是他的日落
goal.ja: Invite the man, not the sunset
goal.es: Invite the man, not the sunset

en: The roof is still drying. Ticket sales came in overnight: people want to come back to “the rain one.” The series might survive August.
So. Next time. Does it have to be a screening? I'm asking if I have to curate you.
I don't understand the question at first. Every good thing I've ever been invited to, I was invited to provide.
Optional. He said it like it was nothing. It's the biggest thing anyone has ever told me.
zh: 屋顶还没干透。一夜之间票卖了出去：大家想再来看“下雨的那场”。这个系列也许能熬过八月了。
所以，下次。一定得是放映吗？我是在问，我是不是得给你也策个展。
我一开始没听懂。我这辈子被邀请去的每一件好事，都是请我去提供点什么。
带你自己来就行。日落可有可无。
可有可无。他说得轻描淡写。这是别人对我说过的最重的一句话。
ja: The roof is still drying. Ticket sales came in overnight: people want to come back to “the rain one.” The series might survive August.
So. Next time. Does it have to be a screening? I'm 聞く if I have to curate you.
I don't understand the question at first. Every good thing I've ever been invited to, I was invited to provide.
Optional. He said it like it was nothing. It's the biggest thing anyone has ever told me.
ko: 지붕이 여전히 말리고 있어. 표 판매가 밤새 들어왔다: 사람들이 "비 오는 것"으로 돌아오기를 원해. 시리즈는 8월을 견뎌낼 수도 있어.
그래. 다음 번. 그건 상영일 필요 없어? 난 큐레이트할 필요가 있냐고 묻고 있어.
난 처음엔 질문을 이해하지 않해. 모든 좋은 것 난 한 번도 초대된 적이 없어, 난 제공하도록 초대됐어.
선택사항. 그게 아무것도 아닌 것처럼 말했어. 그건 가장 큰 것 누군가가 나에게 한 번도 말한 적이 없어.
es: The roof is still drying. Ticket sales came in overnight: people want to come back to “the rain one.” The series might survive August.
So. Next time. Does it have to be a screening? I'm asking if I have to curate you.
I don't understand the question at first. Every good thing I've ever been invited to, I was invited to provide.
Optional. He said it like it was nothing. It's the biggest thing anyone has ever told me.

t.en: Name it: Wednesday, the park bench, snacks.
t.zh: 说定：周三，公园长椅，带零食。
t.ja: Name it: 水曜日, the park bench, snacks.
t.ko: 이름 지어: 수요일, 공원 벤치, 스낵.
t.es: Name it: Wednesday, the park bench, snacks.

en: Wednesday. The bench in Carver Park. I bring snacks. You bring nothing. Whatever the sky does, we sit there and let it.
Nothing. I can bring nothing. I've never practiced nothing.
You'll be a natural. You've got a great face for doing nothing.
zh: 周三。卡弗公园那张长椅。我带零食，你什么都别带。不管天空怎么样，我们就坐在那儿，随它去。
什么都不带。我可以什么都不带。我从没练过“什么都不带”。
你会很有天赋的。你长着一张很适合无所事事的脸。
ja: 水曜日. The bench in Carver Park. I bring snacks. You bring nothing. Whatever the sky does, we sit there and let it.
Nothing. I can bring nothing. I've never practiced nothing.
You'll be a natural. You've got a great face for doing nothing.
ko: 수요일. 칼버 공원의 벤치. 난 스낵을 가져와. 당신은 아무것도 가져와. 하늘이 뭘 하든, 우리는 그곳에 앉고 그걸 하도록 한다.
아무것도. 난 아무것도 가져올 수 있어. 난 아무것도 연습한 적이 없어.
당신이 자연스럽게 될 거야. 당신이 아무것도 하는 것에 좋은 얼굴을 가지고 있어.
es: Wednesday. The bench in Carver Park. I bring snacks. You bring nothing. Whatever the sky does, we sit there and let it.
Nothing. I can bring nothing. I've never practiced nothing.
You'll be a natural. You've got a great face for doing nothing.

mem.en: Isaac invited Sol to sit on a Carver Park bench Wednesday with snacks and no weather; Sol agreed.
mem.zh: Isaac邀请Sol周三带着零食去卡弗公园的长椅坐坐，不要天气；Sol答应了。
mem.ja: Isaac invited Sol to sit on a Carver Park bench 水曜日 with snacks and no weather; Sol agreed.
mem.ko: 아이작은 솔을 수요일에 칼버 공원 벤치에 스낵과 날씨 없이 앉도록 초대했다. 솔은 동의했다.
mem.es: Isaac invited Sol to sit on a Carver Park bench Wednesday with snacks and no weather; Sol agreed.

t.en: Suggest a city event together first.
t.zh: 先提议一起办一场城市活动。
t.ja: Suggest a city event together first.
t.ko: 먼저 도시 이벤트를 함께 제안하다.
t.es: Suggest a city event together first.

en: What if we work together a little longer first? The Eastside gardens want a fundraiser screening. You pick the film, I do the chairs, nobody touches the weather.
A screening for the tomatoes. I'd like that. It feels like — paying something back.
I write it on the clipboard. I also write, smaller, underneath: and then ask him out properly.
zh: 要不我们先再合作一阵子？东区菜园想办一场募捐放映。你选片，我摆椅子，谁都不碰天气。
为番茄办的放映。我喜欢。感觉像——还上点什么。
我把它写在文件夹上。又在下面小字写了一句：然后正式约他。
ja: 何 if we work together a little longer first? The Eastside gardens want a fundraiser screening. You pick the film, I do the chairs, nobody touches the weather.
A screening for the tomatoes. I'd like that. It feels like — paying something back.
I write it on the clipboard. I also write, smaller, underneath: and then ask him out properly.
ko: 만약 우리가 조금 더 오래 함께 일한다면? 동쪽 정원이 기금 모금 상영을 원해. 당신이 영화를 선택하고, 난 의자를 하고, 누구도 날씨를 건드리지 않아.
토마토를 위한 상영. 난 그걸 좋아할 거야. 그건 — 뭔가를 되돌려주는 것처럼 느껴져.
난 그걸 클립보드에 쓴다. 난 또한 쓴다, 더 작게, 아래에: 그리고 나중에 그에게 제대로 묻다.
es: What if we work together a little longer first? The Eastside gardens want a fundraiser screening. You pick the film, I do the chairs, nobody touches the weather.
A screening for the tomatoes. I'd like that. It feels like — paying something back.
I write it on the clipboard. I also write, smaller, underneath: and then ask him out properly.

mem.en: Isaac proposed they co-run a fundraiser screening for the Eastside gardens before anything more; Sol agreed.
mem.zh: Isaac提议先一起为东区菜园办一场募捐放映，再谈其他；Sol同意了。
mem.ja: Isaac proposed they co-run a fundraiser screening for the Eastside gardens before anything more; Sol agreed.
mem.ko: 아이작은 뭔가 더 되기 전에 동쪽 정원을 위한 기금 모금 상영을 공동 실행하도록 제안했다. 솔은 동의했다.
mem.es: Isaac proposed they co-run a fundraiser screening for the Eastside gardens before anything more; Sol agreed.

t.en: Say you need a few weeks off.
t.ja: Say you need a few weeks off.
t.ko: 몇 주 쉬는 것이 필요하다고 말하다.
t.es: Say you need a few weeks off.

en: I need a couple of weeks where nothing about my life is about the sky. It's not a no. It's just — I need to see my own weather for a bit.
The air goes cold around me, and I make it stop. I don't send one cloud after him. Not one.
zh: 我需要几周时间，让生活里没有一件事和天空有关。这不是拒绝。只是——我想先看看我自己的天气。
我周围的空气变冷了，我让它停下。我没往他那边送一朵云。一朵都没有。
ja: I need a couple of weeks where nothing about my life is about the sky. It's not a no. It's just — I need to see my own weather for a bit.
The air goes cold around me, and I make it stop. I don't send one cloud after him. Not one.
ko: 난 몇 주 필요해, 내 인생에서 뭐든 하늘에 대해 없어. 그건 아니야 아니. 그건 그냥 — 난 조금 동안 내 자신의 날씨를 봐야 해.
공기가 내 주위에서 차가워진다, 그리고 난 그것을 멈춘다. 난 한 구름도 그 뒤에 보내지 않아. 하나도.
es: I need a couple of weeks where nothing about my life is about the sky. It's not a no. It's just — I need to see my own weather for a bit.
The air goes cold around me, and I make it stop. I don't send one cloud after him. Not one.

mem.en: Isaac asked for a few weeks' break; Sol accepted without sending any weather after him.
mem.zh: Isaac要求暂停几周；Sol接受了，没有朝他送去任何天气。
mem.ja: Isaac asked for a few weeks' break; Sol accepted without sending any weather after him.
mem.ko: 아이작은 몇 주 휴식을 요청했다. 솔은 그 뒤에 날씨를 보내지 않고 받아들였다.
mem.es: Isaac asked for a few weeks' break; Sol accepted without sending any weather after him.

t.en: An Ordinary Sunset
t.ja: An Ordinary Sunset
t.ko: 보통 일몰
t.es: An Ordinary Sunset

goal.en: Be chosen without changing the weather
goal.zh: 不改变天气，也能被自愿选择
goal.ja: Be chosen without changing the weather
goal.es: Be chosen without changing the weather

en: After an early screening, Sol sits on the bench with both hands flat on his knees. No spell. The sky is hazy and a little gray. The sunset could go either way.
I brought snacks, not a review.
Then I will let the sky do its own thing.
He's holding so still, like the whole city might tip if he breathes. I want him to know he's allowed to just breathe.
zh: 一场早场放映之后，Sol坐在长椅上，两手平放在膝盖上。没有施法。天空朦朦胧胧，有点灰。今天的日落好坏难说。
我带的是零食，不是影评。
那我就让天空自己做主。
他一动不动，好像一呼吸整座城就会倾斜。我想让他知道，他可以只是呼吸。
ja: After an early screening, Sol sits on the bench with both hands flat on his knees. No spell. The sky is hazy and a little gray. The sunset could go either way.
I brought snacks, not a review.
Then I will let the sky do its own thing.
He's holding so still, like the whole city might tip if he breathes. I want him to know he's allowed to just breathe.
ko: 일찍 상영 후, 솔이 벤치에 앉는다, 둘 다 손이 무릎 위에 평평하다. 아니 주문. 하늘이 흐리고 약간 회색이다. 일몰이 어느 쪽이든 갈 수 있어.
그럼 난 하늘이 자신의 것을 하도록 한다.
그가 그렇게 조용하게 들고 있어, 마치 전체 도시가 그가 숨을 쉬면 팁할 수도 있어. 난 그가 그냥 숨을 쉬도록 허락되는 걸 알도록 원해.
es: After an early screening, Sol sits on the bench with both hands flat on his knees. No spell. The sky is hazy and a little gray. The sunset could go either way.
I brought snacks, not a review.
Then I will let the sky do its own thing.
He's holding so still, like the whole city might tip if he breathes. I want him to know he's allowed to just breathe.

t.en: Tell him this is a date.
t.ja: Tell him this is a date.
t.ko: 이것이 데이트라고 말하다.
t.es: Tell him this is a date.

en: For the record, this is a date. Gray sky, stale pretzels, you. That's the whole plan. I'd like more of them.
I laugh, and the haze doesn't move, and neither do I. I just lean into his shoulder.
Forecast: yes. Chance of more, one hundred percent.
zh: 郑重声明，这是约会。灰天、放软了的椒盐卷饼，还有你。这就是全部计划。我想要更多这样的。
我笑了，雾霾没动，我也没动。我只是靠上了他的肩膀。
预报：是。降“更多”概率，百分之百。
ja: For the record, this is a date. Gray sky, stale pretzels, you. That's the whole plan. I'd like more of them.
I laugh, and the haze doesn't move, and neither do I. I just lean into his shoulder.
Forecast: yes. Chance of more, one hundred percent.
ko: 기록을 위해, 이것은 데이트다. 회색 하늘, 신선하지 않은 프레첼, 당신. 그게 전체 계획이야. 난 더 많은 것을 원할 거야.
난 웃고, 안개는 움직이지 않고, 나도. 난 그냥 그의 어깨에 기댄다.
es: For the record, this is a date. Gray sky, stale pretzels, you. That's the whole plan. I'd like more of them.
I laugh, and the haze doesn't move, and neither do I. I just lean into his shoulder.
Forecast: yes. Chance of more, one hundred percent.

mem.en: Isaac told Sol the bench was a date and he wanted more; Sol said yes without changing the sky.
mem.zh: Isaac告诉Sol长椅上这次就是约会，他想要更多；Sol没动天空，答应了。
mem.ja: Isaac told Sol the bench was a date and he wanted more; Sol said yes without changing the sky.
mem.ko: 아이작은 벤치가 데이트라고 솔에게 말했다, 그리고 그는 더 많은 것을 원했다. 솔은 하늘을 바꾸지 않고 그래라고 했다.
mem.es: Isaac told Sol the bench was a date and he wanted more; Sol said yes without changing the sky.

t.en: Say you want slow. Or friends first.
t.zh: 说你想慢一点，或者先做朋友。
t.ja: Say you want slow. Or friends first.
t.ko: 당신이 느리길 원한다고 말하다. 또는 먼저 친구.
t.es: Say you want slow. Or friends first.

en: I like this. I like you. I also want to be sure I like you and not the version of my life where it never rains on the wrong day. Can we go slow?
Slow is a front moving in over three days. I know slow. I'll be patient weather.
They eat the pretzels. The sunset is dull and brownish. They stay for all of it.
zh: 我喜欢这样。我喜欢你。我也想确定我喜欢的是你，而不是那个永远不会在错的日子下雨的人生版本。能慢一点吗？
“慢”就是一道锋面花三天慢慢推进。我懂慢。我会做有耐心的天气。
他们吃着椒盐卷饼。日落暗淡发褐。他们一直看完了。
ja: I like this. I like you. I also want to be sure I like you and not the version of my life where it never rains on the wrong day. Can we go slow?
Slow is a front moving in over three days. I know slow. I'll be patient weather.
They eat the pretzels. The sunset is dull and brownish. They stay for all of it.
ko: 난 이걸 좋아해. 난 당신을 좋아해. 난 또한 나 당신을 좋아하는지 그리고 내 인생의 버전이 아닌지 확실하길 원해, 그곳에서 그건 절대 잘못된 날에 비를 내리지 않아. 우리가 천천히 갈 수 있어?
천천함은 3일 동안 이동 중인 전선이야. 난 천천함을 알아. 난 인내심 있는 날씨가 될 거야.
그들은 프레첼을 먹는다. 일몰은 흐릿하고 갈색이다. 그들은 모든 것이 머물렀다.
es: I like this. I like you. I also want to be sure I like you and not the version of my life where it never rains on the wrong day. Can we go slow?
Slow is a front moving in over three days. I know slow. I'll be patient weather.
They eat the pretzels. The sunset is dull and brownish. They stay for all of it.

mem.en: Isaac said he liked Sol but wanted to go slow; Sol agreed to be patient.
mem.zh: Isaac说喜欢Sol但想慢慢来；Sol答应耐心等待。
mem.ja: Isaac said he liked Sol but wanted to go slow; Sol agreed to be patient.
mem.ko: 아이작은 그가 솔을 좋아하지만 천천히 가기를 원한다고 말했다. 솔은 동의했다.
mem.es: Isaac said he liked Sol but wanted to go slow; Sol agreed to be patient.

t.en: Tell him kindly this is where it ends.
t.zh: 温和地告诉他，到此为止。
t.ja: Tell him kindly this is where it ends.
t.ko: 그걸 친절하게 여기서 끝낸다고 말하다.
t.es: Tell him kindly this is where it ends.

en: I wanted to do this properly, on a normal night, so you'd know it isn't about the rain. I don't think we're a couple. I'm glad we were this.
I hold very, very still. Not a single drop. I promised him that on the first day, and I keep promises.
Thank you for inviting me. Just me. Nobody's done that before.
zh: 我想好好说这件事，在一个普通的晚上，让你知道这和雨无关。我不觉得我们会是一对。但我很高兴我们有过这些。
我一动不动，一滴雨都没有。第一天我就答应过他，我说话算话。
谢谢你邀请我。只邀请我。以前没人这么做过。
ja: I wanted to do this properly, on a normal night, so you'd know it isn't about the rain. I don't think we're a couple. I'm glad we were this.
I hold very, very still. Not a single drop. I promised him that on the first day, and I keep promises.
Thank you for inviting me. Just me. Nobody's done that before.
ko: 난 이거를 제대로 하고 싶었어, 보통 밤에, 그래서 넌 비가 아니야라고 알 거야. 난 우리가 부부라고 생각하지 않아. 난 우리가 이 시간 기쁜 거 감사해.
난 매우, 매우 조용하게 들고 있어. 한 방울도 없어. 난 첫 날 그에게 약속했고, 난 약속을 지킨다.
나를 초대해 줘서 고마워. 그냥 나. 아무도 그 전에 그렇게 한 적이 없어.
es: I wanted to do this properly, on a normal night, so you'd know it isn't about the rain. I don't think we're a couple. I'm glad we were this.
I hold very, very still. Not a single drop. I promised him that on the first day, and I keep promises.
Thank you for inviting me. Just me. Nobody's done that before.

mem.en: Isaac ended the private relationship kindly on an ordinary night; Sol accepted without changing any weather.
mem.zh: Isaac在一个普通的夜晚温和地结束了私人关系；Sol接受了，没有改变任何天气。
mem.ja: Isaac ended the private relationship kindly on an ordinary night; Sol accepted without changing any weather.
mem.ko: 아이작은 개인적인 관계를 종료했다, 친절하게, 보통 밤에. 솔은 날씨를 바꾸지 않고 받아들였다.
mem.es: Isaac ended the private relationship kindly on an ordinary night; Sol accepted without changing any weather.

t.en: A Forecast for Us
t.ja: A Forecast for Us
t.ko: 우리를 위한 예측
t.es: Un Pronóstico para Nosotros

goal.en: Choose ordinary nights together — or keep working side by side
goal.zh: 选择一起过普通的夜晚——或者继续并肩工作
goal.ja: Choose ordinary nights together — or keep working side by side
goal.ko: 보통 밤을 함께 선택하거나 계속 옆으로 일하다
goal.es: Choose ordinary nights together — or keep working side by side

place.zh: 哈德利大楼屋顶，闭幕之夜
place.ja: The Hadley rooftop, 閉じている night

time.ja: 土曜日, 7:30 PM, end of August

en: Closing night, sold out. The series is renewed. Isaac checks the forecast out of habit: every day this week has been perfect over the Hadley Building — and only the Hadley Building.
Sol. The Eastside gardens are dry again.
I look at my hands. I didn't mean to. It just happens now, when I'm near him. Everything wants to be good for him.
I only wanted every night you had to be the right kind.
I have a backup plan for everything. I don't have one for loving someone whose feelings come with a sky.
Whatever I say next, he'll listen. That's the problem and the whole point.
zh: 闭幕之夜，座无虚席，系列续约了。Isaac习惯性地看了眼预报：这一周，哈德利大楼上空每天都完美——而且只有哈德利大楼。
我看着自己的手。我不是故意的。现在只要在他身边，它就自己发生了。一切都想对他好。
我只是想让你过的每一个夜晚，都是对的那种。
我对什么都有备选方案。唯独没有一套方案，用来爱一个情绪自带一片天空的人。
不管我接下来说什么，他都会听。这是问题所在，也是全部意义所在。
ja: Closing night, sold out. The series is renewed. Isaac checks the forecast out of habit: every day this week has been perfect over the Hadley Building — and only the Hadley Building.
Sol. The Eastside gardens are dry again.
I look at my hands. I didn't mean to. It just happens now, when I'm near him. Everything wants to be good for him.
I only wanted every night you had to be the right kind.
I have a backup plan for everything. I don't have one for loving someone whose feelings come with a sky.
Whatever I say next, he'll 聞く. That's the problem and the whole point.
ko: 마감 밤, 매진. 시리즈는 갱신된다. 아이작은 습관에서 예측을 확인한다: 이 주의 모든 날이 헤들리 빌딩 위에서 완벽했다 — 그리고 오직 헤들리 빌딩.
난 내 손을 본다. 난 의도하지 않았어. 그냥 지금 일어나, 그가 근처에 있을 때. 모든 것이 그를 위해 좋길 원해.
난 그냥 넌 가진 모든 밤이 올바른 종류이길 원했어.
난 모든 것을 위한 백업 계획을 가지고 있어. 난 누군가를 사랑하는 것을 위해 계획이 없어, 그의 감정이 하늘과 함께 와.
내가 다음에 말하는 뭐든, 그는 들을 거야. 그건 문제고 전체 포인트다.
es: Closing night, sold out. The series is renewed. Isaac checks the forecast out of habit: every day this week has been perfect over the Hadley Building — and only the Hadley Building.
Sol. The Eastside gardens are dry again.
I look at my hands. I didn't mean to. It just happens now, when I'm near him. Everything wants to be good for him.
I only wanted every night you had to be the right kind.
I have a backup plan for everything. I don't have one for loving someone whose feelings come with a sky.
Whatever I say next, he'll listen. That's the problem and the whole point.

ask.en: What does Isaac ask of the sky — and of Sol?
ask.zh: Isaac对天空——以及对Sol——提出什么？
ask.ja: What does Isaac ask of the sky — and of Sol?
ask.ko: 아이작은 하늘에게 — 그리고 솔에게 뭘 묻는가?
ask.es: What does Isaac ask of the sky — and of Sol?

t.en: Ask him to let tonight be ordinary. With you.
t.zh: 请他让今晚普通一点。和你一起。
t.ja: Ask him to let tonight be ordinary. With you.
t.ko: 그에게 오늘 밤이 보통이 되도록 요청하다. 당신과 함께.
t.es: Ask him to let tonight be ordinary. With you.

en: Give Eastside its rain. Then sit with me. Whatever sunset we get, that's ours. I'm not in love with the weather. I'm in love with the guy in the trash bag.
I let go. Across the river, it rains. Over the roof, the light goes pink and uneven and completely unmanaged.
The sunset is ordinary. They watch all of it, from the second row, holding hands under a poncho nobody needs.
zh: 把雨还给东区。然后陪我坐着。不管等来什么样的日落，那都是我们的。我爱的不是天气，是那个穿垃圾袋的家伙。
我放手了。河对岸下起了雨。屋顶上方，光变成了粉色，不太均匀，完全没人打理。
那是一场普通的日落。他们坐在第二排从头看到尾，在一件谁都用不着的雨披下牵着手。
ja: 与える Eastside its rain. Then sit with me. Whatever sunset we get, that's ours. I'm not in love with the weather. I'm in love with the guy in the trash bag.
I let go. Across the river, it rains. Over the roof, the light goes pink and uneven and completely unmanaged.
The sunset is ordinary. They watch all of it, from the second row, holding hands under a poncho nobody needs.
ko: 동쪽에 비를 주다. 그럼 나와 앉다. 우리가 무슨 일몰이든, 그건 우리의 것이다. 난 날씨에 사랑하지 않아. 난 쓰레기 가방의 남자를 사랑해.
난 풀어준다. 강 건너, 비가 온다. 지붕 위, 빛이 분홍색이고 불균등하고 완전히 관리되지 않는다.
일몰은 보통이야. 그들은 모든 것을 본다, 두 번째 줄에서, 손을 잡고, 누구도 필요하지 않은 판초 아래.
es: Give Eastside its rain. Then sit with me. Whatever sunset we get, that's ours. I'm not in love with the weather. I'm in love with the guy in the trash bag.
I let go. Across the river, it rains. Over the roof, the light goes pink and uneven and completely unmanaged.
The sunset is ordinary. They watch all of it, from the second row, holding hands under a poncho nobody needs.

mem.en: Isaac asked Sol to return Eastside's rain and just be with him; they watched an ordinary sunset together and became a couple.
mem.zh: Isaac请Sol把雨还给东区，只是陪着他；两人一起看了一场普通的日落，正式在一起了。
mem.ja: Isaac asked Sol to 返却 Eastside's rain and just be with him; they watched an ordinary sunset together and became a couple.
mem.ko: 아이작은 솔에게 동쪽의 비를 돌려놓고 그냥 그와 함께 있도록 요청했다. 그들은 보통 일몰을 함께 봤고 부부가 됐다.
mem.es: Isaac asked Sol to return Eastside's rain and just be with him; they watched an ordinary sunset together and became a couple.

t.en: Keep working together. Take romance slowly.
t.ja: Keep working together. 取る romance slowly.
t.ko: 함께 일하는 것을 계속하다. 천천히 로맨스를 가다.
t.es: Keep working together. Take romance slowly.

en: Put the rain back. Then let's do this right: the gardens fundraiser, the winter series, a few more ordinary nights. I want to get to us slowly, where nobody else pays for the speed.
Partners first. I'd like that. It's the first forecast I've made that I can't cheat.
Eastside gets its rain at 9:14 PM. The two of them spend it planning a screening for the gardens, on the same clipboard.
zh: 把雨还回去。然后我们好好来：菜园募捐、冬季系列、再多几个普通的夜晚。我想慢慢走到“我们”，不让任何人为这份速度买单。
先当搭档。我喜欢。这是我第一次做一个没法作弊的预报。
晚上9:14，东区等来了雨。他们俩就在那段时间里，用同一个文件夹，规划着给菜园的放映。
ja: Put the rain back. Then let's do this right: the gardens fundraiser, the winter series, a few more ordinary nights. I want to get to us slowly, where nobody else pays for the speed.
Partners first. I'd like that. It's the first forecast I've made that I can't cheat.
Eastside gets its rain at 9:14 PM. The two of them spend it planning a screening for the gardens, on the same clipboard.
ko: 비를 다시 놓다. 그럼 우리가 이것을 제대로 하자: 정원 기금 모금, 겨울 시리즈, 더 많은 보통 밤. 난 우리에게 천천히 가기를 원해, 그곳에서 아무도 속도를 위해 다른 것을 급료하지 않아.
먼저 파트너. 난 그걸 좋아할 거야. 그건 첫 예측 난 만든 적이 없어, 난 속일 수 없어.
동쪽이 오후 9시 14분에 비를 받는다. 둘 다 정원을 위한 상영을 계획하는 데 보낸다, 같은 클립보드에.
es: Put the rain back. Then let's do this right: the gardens fundraiser, the winter series, a few more ordinary nights. I want to get to us slowly, where nobody else pays for the speed.
Partners first. I'd like that. It's the first forecast I've made that I can't cheat.
Eastside gets its rain at 9:14 PM. The two of them spend it planning a screening for the gardens, on the same clipboard.

mem.en: Isaac and Sol chose to keep working together on city events and let romance come slowly; Sol returned Eastside's rain.
mem.zh: Isaac和Sol选择继续一起办城市活动，感情慢慢来；Sol把雨还给了东区。
mem.ja: Isaac and Sol chose to keep working together on city events and let romance come slowly; Sol 返却ed Eastside's rain.
mem.ko: 아이작과 솔은 도시 이벤트에서 함께 일하는 것을 계속하기로 선택했고, 로맨스는 천천히 오도록 했다. 솔이 동쪽의 비를 돌렸다.
mem.es: Isaac and Sol chose to keep working together on city events and let romance come slowly; Sol returned Eastside's rain.

t.en: End the private dates. Keep the sky honest.
t.zh: 结束私下约会，让天空保持诚实。
t.ja: End the private dates. 保つ the sky honest.
t.ko: 비공개 날짜를 종료하다. 하늘을 정직하게 유지하다.
t.es: End the private dates. Keep the sky honest.

en: I can't be the reason the weather's unfair. As long as being near me bends the sky, I have to stop seeing you. Not as a punishment. As a boundary.
The air goes cold. I don't let it go further. No flood, no storm, nothing that says he's wrong. He isn't.
I'll fix Eastside. All summer, if it takes that. Not to win you back. Because it's mine to fix.
Isaac finishes the series without him. By September, the gardens are green again. Nobody on the rooftop crew mentions the umbrella Isaac still carries.
zh: 我不能成为天气不公平的原因。只要待在我身边就会让天空弯曲，我就得停止和你见面。这不是惩罚，是界限。
空气变冷了。我没让它继续下去。没有洪水，没有暴雨，没有任何东西在说他错了。他没错。
我会把东区修好。要一整个夏天也行。不是为了赢回你。是因为那是我该修的。
Isaac在没有他的情况下办完了这个系列。到九月，菜园又绿了。屋顶场务里没人提起Isaac仍随身带着的那把伞。
ja: I can't be the reason the weather's unfair. As long as being near me bends the sky, I have to stop seeing you. Not as a punishment. As a boundary.
The air goes cold. I don't let it go further. No flood, no storm, nothing that says he's wrong. He isn't.
I'll fix Eastside. All summer, if it takes that. Not to win you back. Because it's mine to fix.
Isaac finishes the series without him. By September, the gardens are green again. Nobody on the rooftop crew mentions the umbrella Isaac still carries.
ko: 난 날씨가 불공정한 이유가 될 수 없어. 나 근처에 있는 것이 하늘을 구부리는 한, 난 당신을 보는 것을 멈춰야 해. 처벌로 아니라. 경계로.
공기가 차가워진다. 난 그것을 더 가도록 하지 않는다. 홍수도, 폭풍도, 그건 그가 틀렸다고 말하는 아무것도.
난 동쪽을 고친다. 모든 여름, 만약 그것이 그 시간을 걸린다면. 당신을 돌려받으려고 아니라. 왜냐하면 그건 내 것을 고치다.
아이작은 그 없이 시리즈를 마친다. 9월까지, 정원이 다시 초록이다. 아무도 옥상 승무원에서 언급하지 않는 아이작이 여전히 들고 있는 우산.
es: I can't be the reason the weather's unfair. As long as being near me bends the sky, I have to stop seeing you. Not as a punishment. As a boundary.
The air goes cold. I don't let it go further. No flood, no storm, nothing that says he's wrong. He isn't.
I'll fix Eastside. All summer, if it takes that. Not to win you back. Because it's mine to fix.
